author: FangedAngel
title: A myth to behold
summary:
The Outsider doesn't know why he's here. He can feel the Void calling to him, but he is intrigued by the way in which Corvo's pain resonates with him when it shouldn't affect him in any way. He's seen many empires fall and many lives shattered in the name of many causes. He's seen unimaginable destruction and horror, and too much death, but he's barely ever found himself feeling involved in any of it. The closest he got to feeling anything more than mild interest was when he marked the rat boy, and even then he'd only felt mild disappointment in the end, a hint of remorse at the loss of so many other futures. He supposes that his mistake of getting involved in saving Corvo when he was a boy is behind all this, but he feels like he couldn't have avoided that. In all the glimpses of Corvo's futures he's been able to see, he's always intrinsically entwined with the Outsider in a way the god cannot begin to explain.
Or: the Outsider's 'fascination' with Corvo starts earlier than Corvo might have thought, and allows Delilah to get away with a lot. Featuring: lots of long sentences, very little dialogue, and lots of Corvo thinking. Also lots of canon divergence in terms of plot and characters.

Before Jin Guangshan could stand, Nie Mingjue had held out a hand to stop him.

Instead, Nie Mingjue had turned to Jin Guangshan and requested to fetch Mo Xuanyu whenever he needed to. Mo Xuanyu was appointed a position as an advisor as sorts. He comes to his senses in a dark, empty cave, amidst the rocks and rubble he brought down with himself. Somewhere above him, a sliver of a red sky can be seen, far enough that he can’t reach it. Not now, when he barely moves.

It’s the idea, the will and determination to transfer consciousness in iterations, to slither one’s thoughts into the cracks of the world where there are none. He’s done it, he thinks. He has never tried it, he fears. He sees no point in doing it, he knows. But

   

  There is something he should remember.

author: Shizuku206
title: What We Learn With Pleasure
summary:
“We just want what’s best for you," Sir Maurice said. "And you’re not the only young man to struggle with this aspect of life. There are ways you can learn, and gain confidence in courting, and all that involves.”

“I’m afraid I don’t know quite what you mean, sir.”

“The Private Bureau offers just such a service for single men. A series of lessons. You’ll be paired with an experienced tutor, who will teach you each skill, help you practice, and when you graduate from the program, you’ll make a very fine husband, attractive to any young lady who may strike your fancy.”

“Lessons? Tutor? I really don’t think such things are necessary, sir. I’m not—I just haven’t—I’m waiting for the right woman. I’ve no pressing desire to marry, and I shouldn’t want to take a place from another fellow with a more urgent need.”

“Nonsense, Archie. The lessons will do you good. I’m setting my best man on the job. Mr. da Silva. You’ll feel like a different man after completing the course! I’m sure of it.”
